method: Actual official statements + official API ratings + original independent mathematical proofs; no official-editorial-read claim.

reviews.statement_summary: Aggregate a multiset of positive values; selecting one value earns it and removes adjacent values, maximize score for n and values up to100000.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: For any value x, once selected its remaining copies can all be selected without hurting a choice at distance>=2. Aggregate w[x]=x*count[x]. An independent-set DP on consecutive values gives f[x]=max(f[x-1],f[x-2]+w[x]). The alternatives are disjoint and exhaustive.64-bit arithmetic is necessary. O(n+maxValue).

reviews.statement_summary: Count red/white flower sequences of lengths in query intervals; consecutive white flowers come in k-sized blocks, t,k and upper lengths<=100000, modulo1e9+7.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: The last token is one red flower or one block of k white flowers, giving dp[0]=1 and dp[i]=dp[i-1]+dp[i-k] when i>=k. Parsing a white run into fixed k-sized blocks is unique, including k=1. Prefix sums answer each inclusive range via pref[b]-pref[a-1] modulo1e9+7. O(maxBound+t).

reviews.statement_summary: Cut a ribbon of length n into lengths a,b,c, maximizing the piece count; n,a,b,c<=4000, a feasible exact cutting is guaranteed.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: Unbounded exact-sum DP: dp[0]=0, unreachable lengths=-INF, dp[i]=max(dp[i-l]+1) over allowed lengths l with a reachable predecessor. Last-piece removal proves exhaustiveness; every transition builds a valid cutting. Increasing length is a DAG since l>0. O(n) with three choices; duplicated lengths harmless.

reviews.statement_summary: Keep a fixed sequence of strings, optionally reverse each for cost ci<=1e9; make the sequence nondecreasing lexicographically, equal strings allowed, total length<=100000.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: Two states per prefix store the minimum cost with the last string kept/reversed. A transition from previous orientation p to current q is allowed iff oriented(previous,p)<=oriented(current,q), adding ci only for q=1. Only adjacent comparisons matter and previous history affects feasibility solely through its last orientation. Use64-bit INF; O(totalLength+n) character-comparison work up to a constant.

reviews.statement_summary: Count root-starting paths in an infinite k-ary weighted tree with sum n and at least one edge>=d; n,k<=100,1<=d<=k, modulo1e9+7.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: A path is an ordered composition using parts1..k. DP on total sum and whether a weight>=d has appeared: start dp[0][0]=1, append each weight w and update flag OR(w>=d). Every composition has a unique last edge, so no double count. dp[n][1] is the answer. O(nk), O(n); order matters, d=1 and n<d are handled.

reviews.statement_summary: Choose rest/contest/gym over n<=100 days according to a day bitmask; identical non-rest activities cannot occur on adjacent days, minimize rest days.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: DP states store the previous day activity0(rest),1(contest),2(gym). Rest transition from all states adds1; contest (mask&1) from previous!=1 adds0, gym(mask&2) from previous!=2 adds0. Start only rest-state cost0 before day1. Previous activity is the entire needed history; optimal substructure gives O(n), O(1). Repeated rests allowed.
